notes:
## Changes

- **Media Wall** (new): play several scenes at once in a tidy grid. Right-click a scene and choose **Add to Media Wall**, use the Media Wall button on the selection bar, or open it from **View › Media Wall**.
  - Pick a layout (2 × 2, 3 × 3, one big and several small, and more), or make and save your own by joining cells together.
  - Scenes start at a random point with the sound off. Sound plays in one video at a time: right-click a video and choose **Switch sound to this one**; the one with sound has a coloured frame and a Sound marker. The speaker button on the toolbar turns sound off and back on.
  - More scenes than zones? The rest wait in the **Queue**, where you can reorder them, play one next or take it out.
  - Each video chooses what happens when it ends: play the next in the queue, play it again, or stop.
  - Double-click a video to watch it alone, full screen; double-click again to go back to the wall. In full screen, move the mouse to the top edge for the toolbar.
  - The Media Wall plays with VLC. Use VLC if it's installed, or download its player from VideoLAN in Settings › Player and tools (about 83 MB, only when you ask).
linuxNotes:
First Linux preview of Video Shelf: the whole app on Ubuntu and similar systems (.deb). It uses the same catalogue as the Windows app.

Install with:

    sudo apt install ./videoshelf_0.12.0_amd64.deb
